1039.description: A full range machine squat that builds the thighs and glutes with a guided path.
instructions: Step into the machine with the pads on your shoulders and feet shoulder width apart.
Release the safety and brace your core.
Squat as deep as you comfortably can.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up and knees over your toes.

1103.description: A dip with suspension handles. It trains the triceps.
instructions: Hold the handles with arms straight.
Keep your body upright.
Lower by bending your elbows.
Keep your elbows close.
Press back up.
Stay controlled.

1167.description: A dynamic chest stretch, swinging the arms out and across the chest. It loosens the chest and shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms straight out to the sides, parallel to the ground.
Slowly bring your arms forward, crossing them in front of your body.
Feel the stretch in your chest muscles.
Hold the stretch for 10-30 seconds.
Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将双臂伸直至两侧，与地面平行。
慢慢地将双臂向前伸，交叉在身体前面。
感受胸部肌肉的伸展。
保持拉伸 10-30 秒。
返回起始位置并重复所需的重复次数。

1231.description: A seated overhead press with one dumbbell. Working one arm at a time shows any imbalances.
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support, holding a dumbbell at your shoulder.
Brace your core.
Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

1295.description: A dumbbell pullover performed on a stability ball. The arc behind your head stretches the chest and lats and keeps your core busy.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball and hold a dumbbell with both hands above your chest, arms extended.
Slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head while keeping your arms straight.
Pause for a moment, then raise the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双手握住哑铃，置于胸前，双臂伸展。
慢慢地将哑铃放到脑后，同时保持手臂伸直。
暂停片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1359.description: A bent over row using a smith machine bar with an overhand grip. The fixed path helps you focus on the upper back and lats.
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the bar at hip height.
Stand facing the bar with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Pull the bar towards your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机设置为与臀部高度相同的杠铃。
面向杠铃站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
正手握住杠铃，双手距离略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃拉向下胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1423.description: Lie face down with your hips at the end of a bench and swing your legs up behind you. It works the glutes and lower back.
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with your hips at the edge and your legs hanging off the bench.
Hold onto the bench for stability.
Keeping your legs straight, raise them up towards the ceiling as high as you can.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 脸朝下躺在平坦的长凳上，臀部位于边缘，双腿悬在长凳上。
抓住长凳以保持稳定。
保持双腿伸直，尽可能将它们抬向天花板。
在动作的最高点挤压臀部。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1487.description: An inverted yoga pose balanced on the shoulders. It builds shoulder and core control and stretches the neck-side muscles.
instructions: Lie on your back and lift your legs overhead, supporting your lower back with your hands.
Walk your hands up toward your shoulder blades.
Raise your legs straight up so your body forms a line over your shoulders.
Keep your neck long and still, and do not turn your head.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.

1551.description: A rear-foot-elevated lunge using a decline bench and dumbbells. The raised back foot shifts the load onto the front leg.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing away from a decline bench.
Place the top of one foot on the bench behind you.
Lower your hips straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Push through your front foot to rise, then switch legs after your reps.

1615.description: A preacher curl on a lever machine with a neutral hammer grip. It hits the brachialis and forearms along with the biceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the leverage machine.
Place your upper arms on the preacher pad, ensuring your chest is pressed against it.
Grasp the handles with a hammer grip (palms facing each other).
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the handles towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在杠杆机上。
将你的上臂放在讲道垫上，确保你的胸部压在上面。
用锤子握把抓住手柄（手掌相对）。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将手柄卷向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1679.description: A one-arm curl seated on an exercise ball with one leg raised. It trains the biceps and balance.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing up and your arm fully extended.
Place your other hand on your hip for stability.
Slowly curl the dumbbell towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your bicep.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the exercise.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，手掌朝上，手臂完全伸展。
将另一只手放在臀部上以保持稳定。
慢慢地将哑铃向肩膀弯曲，保持上臂静止。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
交换手臂并重复练习。

1743.description: A dumbbell bench press with a wrist twist through the rep. Works chest and triceps while adding a rotating element.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip, palms facing away from you.
Extend your arms straight up over your chest, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the dumbbells down towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
As you lower the dumbbells, twist your wrists so that your palms face towards you at the bottom of the movement.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then reverse the movement by pressing the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
As you press the dumbbells up, twist your wrists back to the starting position with palms facing away from you.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
双手各握一个哑铃，正手握握，手掌背向自己。
将手臂伸直越过胸部，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
将哑铃向胸部方向降低，保持肘部靠近身体。
放下哑铃时，扭转手腕，使手掌在动作底部面向自己。
在底部暂停片刻，然后通过将哑铃推回到起始位置来反转动作。
当你向上推哑铃时，将手腕扭转回起始位置，手掌背向自己。
重复所需的重复次数。

1807.description: Sitting cross-legged and reaching forward opens your lower back and hips. It is a calm stretch that suits cooldowns.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs crossed and your back tall.
Walk your hands forward along the floor and fold from your hips until you feel a stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1871.description: Seated plate-loaded dip machine that builds the triceps.
instructions: Sit upright and grip the handles beside you.
Set your elbows tight to your sides.
Press down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly to the start.

1935.description: Lying on your back and drawing a crossed knee up toward the opposite shoulder to stretch the glutes and hips.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the knee of the lower leg or behind the thigh and pull it up toward your chest.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2127.description: A captain's chair leg raise with added weight, building lower ab and hip flexor strength.
instructions: Position yourself on a captain's chair with your forearms on the pads and back against the backrest.
Hold the weight securely between your feet or on your ankles.
Brace your core and raise your knees or legs up toward your chest.
Curl your pelvis slightly at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.
Repeat for the planned reps.

2511.description: A chest-supported dumbbell row with an underhand grip for the lats and upper back.
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding dumbbells with an underhand grip.
Let your arms hang straight.
Row the dumbbells toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest on the pad.

2767.description: Lifting the leg out to the side away from the body, working the outer hip and glutes.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Lift the other leg straight out to the side, toes pointing forward.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly without leaning your torso.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2831.description: A pike push up with your feet raised on a bench, shifting more load to the shoulders. A bodyweight alternative to the overhead press.
instructions: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor, hips raised in an inverted V.
Keep your legs straight and your core braced.
Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees to your body.

2895.description: A high plank where you lift one arm at a time, training anti-rotation core strength.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Set your feet slightly wider for balance.
Lift one hand and reach it forward without twisting your hips.
Place it down and switch arms.
Keep your core braced throughout.

3023.description: Lying hip internal rotation against a band to build control through the hip.
instructions: Lie on your back with a band around your lower leg anchored to the side.
Bend your knees with your feet on the floor.
Rotate your lower leg outward against the band, turning the hip inward.
Return slowly to the start.
Complete your reps and switch legs.

3215.description: A toe touch with the hands clasped in reverse and moved in a circle. It opens the hamstrings and back while warming up the hips.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended to the sides.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Reach down with your hands and clasp them together behind your legs.
Slowly raise your hands up and over your head in a circular motion, keeping your legs straight.
Continue the circular motion until your hands touch your toes.
Reverse the motion and bring your hands back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手向下伸，并在腿后将它们握在一起。
慢慢地将双手举过头顶，做圆周运动，保持双腿伸直。
继续圆周运动，直到双手触及脚趾。
反转动作并将双手放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3279.description: A crunch with the calves resting on a bench, which keeps the hips bent and focuses the work on the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back and rest your lower legs on a bench, knees bent at about 90 degrees.
Place your hands lightly behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor by squeezing your abs.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat without pulling on your neck.

3343.description: A machine lateral raise that isolates the side delts with smooth, guided resistance.
instructions: Adjust the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine pivots.
Sit tall and place your arms against the pads.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without letting the weights rest.

3407.description: A standing trunk rotation at lower body level to loosen the hips and waist.
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than your hips and knees soft.
Hold your hands in front of your waist.
Rotate your hips and trunk to one side.
Return through the centre and rotate to the other side.
Move smoothly for 10-15 reps per side.

3471.description: A standing yoga pose that builds strength and stretches the hips.
instructions: Take a long stance.
Bend your front knee over your ankle.
Raise your arms.
Keep your back leg straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

3535.description: A squat held at the bottom with small pulses. It burns the quads and glutes.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until thighs are parallel.
Pulse up and down a few centimetres.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Keep your weight on your heels.
Stand up fully to finish.

3663.description: A reverse plank where you lift one leg at a time. It trains the abs, glutes and the back of the body.
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you and your hands resting on the ground behind you, fingers pointing towards your feet.
Press through your hands and lift your hips off the ground, coming into a reverse plank position.
Engage your core and lift one leg off the ground, extending it straight up towards the ceiling.
Hold for a moment, then lower your leg back down.
Repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在地上，双腿向前伸展，双手放在身后的地面上，手指指向脚部。
双手用力，将臀部抬离地面，进入反向平板支撑位置。
启动你的核心并将一条腿抬离地面，将其笔直向上伸向天花板。
保持一会儿，然后将腿放下。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。

3727.description: A front squat to a bench behind you, which helps with depth control and keeps the load in front.
instructions: Place a bench behind you and rest the bar across your front shoulders.
Keep your elbows high and your chest up.
Sit back and down until you lightly touch the bench.
Drive through your feet to stand.
Avoid rocking or collapsing onto the bench.

3791.description: A front plank with a one-arm band pulldown. It trains core stability while your arm works against the band.
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and set up in a forearm or high plank.
Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
Pull the band down with one hand toward your hip without twisting.
Return the arm slowly to the start.
Alternate arms and keep your body in one straight line.

3855.description: A standing movement where you arch and then round your back. It warms up your spine.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip width apart and hands on your hips.
Gently arch your back and look slightly up.
Round your back and tuck your chin.
Move slowly between positions.
Stay within a comfortable range.

3919.description: A reverse lunge holding a landmine bar at the chest, working the quads and glutes.
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front foot to stand.
Alternate legs.

3983.description: A front plank held with one arm lifted. It tests anti-rotation core strength.
instructions: Start in a high plank with feet wide.
Lift one hand off the floor.
Hold your hips steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch arms.

4047.description: Dead bug with a kettlebell held above the chest. The weight adds challenge to the core while the limbs move.
instructions: Lie on your back and hold a kettlebell by the horns above your chest.
Lift your knees to a tabletop position.
Slowly extend one leg while pressing your lower back into the floor.
Bring the leg back and switch.
Keep the kettlebell steady and breathe.

4111.description: A seated shrug using a horizontal cable pull, keeping steady tension on the traps.
instructions: Sit facing a low cable with a handle in each hand.
Start with arms straight and shoulders forward.
Pull your shoulders back and up.
Squeeze your traps at the end.
Return slowly to the start.

4175.description: A standing overhead press with weight in hand. It builds shoulder and triceps strength.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, weight at shoulder height.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the weight straight overhead.
Lock out without leaning back.
Lower slowly to your shoulders.
Keep your ribs down.

4239.description: A supported one-arm reverse fly that isolates the rear delts. Bracing with your other hand helps you keep a steady torso.
instructions: Hinge forward and brace your free hand on a bench or support.
Hold a light dumbbell hanging straight down.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side with a slight elbow bend.
Lift until your arm is about parallel to the floor.
Pause and lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch arms.

4367.description: A bent-over row with a cable using an underhand grip, which emphasizes the lower lats and biceps.
instructions: Stand facing a low cable and hinge forward with a flat back.
Grip the bar with palms up.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.

4431.description: A lying neck exercise moving the head side to side against light resistance to strengthen the neck.
instructions: Lie face up with a light weight on your forehead.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly turn your head toward one side.
Return to the middle and turn the other way.
Use light weight and smooth movement.

4495.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the upper forearm (supinator). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your upper forearm (supinator) on a table with your arm resting on it.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4559.description: A kneeling stretch with the arms on a bench that opens the lats and shoulders.
instructions: Kneel in front of a bench and place both elbows on top of it.
Keep your hands together or hold a light stick.
Sit your hips back and let your chest sink toward the floor.
Keep your lower back relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Come back up carefully.

4623.description: A seated tuck that brings the knees and chest together while holding a weight, targeting the lower abs.
instructions: Sit on the floor holding a weight at your chest, leaning back slightly with legs extended.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Pull your knees in while bringing your chest forward.
Extend your legs again without touching the floor.
Keep your back long and breathe steadily.

4687.description: A curl with palms facing each other against tube resistance, training the biceps and forearms.
instructions: Stand on the middle of the band and hold the handles with palms facing in.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the handles up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly under tension.

4751.description: A glute bridge with a dumbbell resting on your hips. It strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Rest a dumbbell on your hips and hold it in place.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

5007.description: A hammer curl using suspension straps with palms facing each other. It works the biceps and the muscles beside them.
instructions: Hold the handles with palms facing each other and lean back.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Curl your hands toward your head.
Keep your elbows high and still.
Lower slowly until arms are straight.
Keep your core tight.

5071.description: Lunge while holding one kettlebell locked out overhead. The overhead load challenges balance, shoulder stability and the legs.
instructions: Press a kettlebell overhead with one arm and keep that arm straight.
Step forward into a lunge and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your ribs down and the weight stacked over your shoulder.
Push back to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch the kettlebell to the other arm.

5135.description: A seated twist held as a stretch. It opens the spine and the muscles around your waist.
instructions: Sit tall with legs crossed or extended.
Place one hand behind you and the other on the opposite knee.
Rotate your torso toward the back hand.
Keep your spine long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

5327.description: A Romanian deadlift on a T-bar lever machine. Targets the hamstrings and glutes with a guided path.
instructions: Stand at the T-bar lever and grip the handles.
Lift to stand with a slight bend in your knees.
Push your hips back and lower the bar along your thighs.
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Keep your back flat all the way.

5391.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the glutes. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie on your back with the roller under one glute.
Place the roller under the glutes and let your body weight settle onto it.
Let the knees drop to one side and twist gently.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5583.description: A machine crunch on a curved track that lets you curl your trunk and knees together. Builds the abs under load.
instructions: Sit on the machine, set the seat and grab the handles.
Place your legs on the pads and keep your back against the support.
Exhale and crunch your torso and knees toward each other.
Pause when your abs are fully squeezed.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.

5903.description: A halfway forward fold with a flat back. Lengthens the back of the legs.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward from your hips and bring your hands to your shins or thighs.
Lengthen your spine until your back is flat.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Roll up slowly to stand.

5967.description: A footwork and reaction drill with a ball that sharpens agility, balance and quick direction changes.
instructions: Set up with a ball in front of you in an athletic stance.
Move quickly around or over the ball with short, light steps.
Keep your hips low and eyes up.
Change direction without crossing your feet.
Work for 20-30 seconds, rest, then repeat.

6159.description: A seated overhead triceps extension with one dumbbell. This version uses the left arm.
instructions: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in your left hand overhead.
Keep the upper arm close to your head.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbow.
Extend the arm back to full lockout.
Keep your core braced.
Finish your reps, then switch to the right arm.

6543.description: A front raise using a rope on a low cable. The cable keeps tension on the front shoulder through the whole lift.
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and face away from the machine.
Hold the rope ends and let your arms hang with the cable between your legs.
Raise your arms forward to shoulder height with soft elbows.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without letting the stack rest.
Keep your torso still, no swinging.

6607.description: Side stepping with a loop band around the legs. It fires up the hip abductors and glutes.
instructions: Put a loop band around your legs just above the knees or ankles.
Stand in a quarter squat with feet hip-width apart.
Step sideways with the lead foot, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the feet touch.
Walk several steps one way, then return the other way.

6735.description: A hip thrust with a dumbbell on the hips and a band around the thighs. The band keeps the glutes working to hold the knees out.
instructions: Put a band around your thighs and rest your upper back on a bench.
Place a dumbbell across your hips and hold it steady.
Plant your feet and push your knees out against the band.
Drive your hips up until your torso is level.
Squeeze the glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.

6799.description: A lying V-up to the side while holding a dumbbell. It works the abs and obliques hard.
instructions: Lie on your back holding a dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Lift your legs and torso together, angling toward one side.
Reach the dumbbell toward your feet.
Lower back down slowly.
Alternate sides each rep.

7055.description: A standing twisting move holding a plate that works the forearm rotators. It builds wrist and grip strength.
instructions: Stand holding a plate at its sides in front of you.
Keep your elbows bent and close to your sides.
Rotate the plate left and right using your wrists and forearms.
Move slowly and under control.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.

8143.description: A dip on high parallel bars with an upright torso. It builds the triceps and chest.
instructions: Grip the bars and lift yourself with straight arms.
Keep your body upright and elbows close.
Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders.

8399.description: A plank where you tap a hand to the floor at the side, challenging the obliques and anti-rotation control.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders and feet wide.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Reach one hand out to tap the floor at the side without twisting your hips.
Return it and tap with the other hand.
Keep the pace steady and controlled.

8655.description: A seated arm circle with palms up to warm up the shoulder joints.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Extend your arms out to the sides with palms facing up.
Draw small circles, then gradually bigger.
Reverse the direction after a set.

8847.description: A standing machine lateral raise that isolates the side shoulders.
instructions: Stand in the machine with pads against your arms.
Keep your torso upright.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

9359.description: A one-legged bridge with your heel planted that works the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot flat and the other leg raised.
Press your heel into the floor.
Lift your hips until your body forms a line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

9487.description: From a seated position with hands behind you, you lift your legs to train the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your hands planted behind your hips and legs extended.
Lean back slightly and brace your abs.
Raise both legs together a short way off the floor.
Lower them slowly without letting your heels drop to the ground.
Repeat for the planned reps.

9679.description: A hopping drill where you drive a knee up and tap it with your hand. It raises the heart rate and builds coordination.
instructions: Stand tall with one hand held out in front at waist height.
Hop on one leg while driving the opposite knee up to tap your hand.
Land softly and quickly switch legs.
Keep your chest upright.
Continue at a lively pace for 20-30 seconds.

9871.description: A single-arm cable Y raise using wrist straps, so your grip does not limit the shoulder work.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with the strap on one wrist.
Let your arm hang down.
Raise it up and out in a Y shape.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

9999.description: A plank with alternating knee taps to the floor. It trains the abs and anti-rotation control.
instructions: Start in a forearm or high plank.
Brace your core.
Lower one knee gently toward the floor.
Return it and switch sides.
Keep your hips level.
Breathe steadily.

10191.description: A goblet squat that steps around an imaginary clock, training the legs from several directions.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and picture a clock on the floor around you.
Step to 12 o'clock and squat down with your chest up.
Stand up and return to the center.
Step to the next position on the clock and squat again.
Work your way around the clock with control and switch direction on the next set.

10383.description: A deadlift with a sandbag, building hip and back strength with an awkward, grippy load.
instructions: Stand over a sandbag with feet hip width apart.
Hinge at your hips, bend your knees and grip the bag.
Brace your core and drive through your feet to stand tall with the bag.
Push your hips back and lower the bag to the floor.
Keep your back flat throughout.

10639.description: A full-range sit-up on a glute ham developer. The extended range makes the abs and hip flexors work through a long path.
instructions: Lock your feet in the machine and sit with your hips on the pad.
Lean back until your torso is in line with or just below your hips.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl up until your chest reaches your thighs.
Lower back slowly with a braced core.
Avoid yanking on your neck.

11279.description: A one-arm overhead triceps extension with a cable. The overhead position stretches and works the long head of the triceps.
instructions: Hold a handle from a low pulley overhead, elbow bent, with your upper arm close to your head.
Brace your core.
Straighten your arm overhead.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

11791.description: A hand-strengthening drill pressing the fingers into a ball.
instructions: Hold a small ball in one palm.
Press down on it with your fingers.
Spread and squeeze with control, keeping your wrist neutral.
Hold the press for 2-3 seconds.
Repeat for reps, then switch hands.

0015.description: A machine-assisted pull-up on parallel bars with a close neutral grip. Builds the lats and biceps with less bodyweight.
instructions: Adjust the machine to your desired weight and height.
Place your hands on the parallel bars with a close grip, palms facing each other.
Hang from the bars with your arms fully extended and your feet off the ground.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bars, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bars.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将机器调整到您想要的重量和高度。
将双手紧紧握在双杠上，手掌相对。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，双脚离开地面。
收紧背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃，保持肘部靠近身体。
继续拉，直到下巴高于杠铃。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0079.description: A reverse wrist curl with the forearms resting on the thighs. Builds the muscles on top of the forearms.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent.
Hold a barbell with an overhand grip, palms facing down, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, allowing your wrists to hang off the edge.
Keeping your forearms stationary, exhale and curl your wrists upward as far as possible.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause, then inhale and slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲。
正手握住杠铃，手掌朝下，双手与肩同宽。
将前臂放在大腿上，让手腕悬在边缘。
保持前臂静止，呼气并尽可能向上弯曲手腕。
保持收缩位置短暂停顿，然后吸气并慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0143.description: A bridge hold on straight arms like the top of a push-up. It trains the abs and shoulder stability.
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Extend your legs behind you with your toes on the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower your knees to rest.

0207.description: A pushdown with an underhand grip on a high pulley. Switching the grip shifts more load onto the triceps' medial head.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley cable machine.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary throughout the exercise.
Using your triceps, push the bar down until your arms are fully extended and your triceps are contracted.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return the bar to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将直杆连接到高滑轮电缆机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
反手握住杠铃，手掌朝上，双手与肩同宽。
在整个练习过程中，保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
使用三头肌，将杠铃向下推，直到手臂完全伸展并且三头肌收缩。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将杠铃返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0271.description: A crunch done on a stability ball. The ball adds a wider range and demands balance, working the abs.
instructions: Sit on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Lie back on the ball until your lower back is supported and your upper body is parallel to the floor.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body towards your knees, curling your torso forward.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
仰卧在球上，直到下背部得到支撑并且上半身与地板平行。
将双手放在脑后或放在胸前。
收紧腹肌，将上身抬向膝盖，躯干向前卷曲。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0335.description: A combination raise that goes out to the side and then to the front. It works all the delts in one move.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the ground, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Next, raise your arms in front of you until they are parallel to the ground, again keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
保持背部挺直并启动核心肌群。
将手臂向两侧举起，直到与地面平行，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
接下来，将手臂举到身前，直到它们与地面平行，再次保持肘部稍微弯曲。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0399.description: Seated, you rotate a dumbbell with one forearm, turning the palm up and down. It trains forearm control and wrist strength.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and hold a dumbbell in one hand, resting it on your thigh.
Raise the dumbbell up to shoulder height, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your body, while keeping your upper arm stationary.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly rotate your forearm back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，一只手握住哑铃，将其放在大腿上。
将哑铃举至肩膀高度，保持肘部靠近身体。
向外旋转前臂，远离身体，同时保持上臂静止。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢旋转前臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

0463.description: The classic forearm plank. Holding a straight line from head to heels builds core endurance and stability.
instructions: Lie face down and prop yourself on your forearms, elbows under your shoulders.
Lift your hips and knees off the floor, resting on your toes.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your abs and glutes.
Hold for 20-60 seconds while breathing steadily.
Don't let your hips sag or pike up.

0527.description: With two kettlebells you drive from the rack to overhead using legs and arms. It builds the shoulders and legs.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder height.
Bend your knees slightly and engage your core.
Press the kettlebells overhead, fully extending your arms.
Bend your knees and quickly drop into a partial squat.
Explosively extend your hips and knees, driving the kettlebells overhead.
Lock out your arms and catch the kettlebells overhead with your knees slightly bent.
Stand up straight and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个壶铃，与肩同高。
稍微弯曲膝盖并启动核心。
将壶铃压过头顶，充分伸展手臂。
弯曲膝盖并快速半蹲。
爆发性地伸展臀部和膝盖，将壶铃举过头顶。
锁定双臂，将壶铃举过头顶，膝盖稍微弯曲。
站直并回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0591.description: On a dip machine, you press the handles down and extend your elbows. Focuses on the triceps and chest.
instructions: Adjust the machine to the appropriate height and secure your body in position.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your body so that your arms are fully extended.
Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms close to your sides.
Continue lowering until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by extending your elbows.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将机器调整到合适的高度并将身体固定到位。
正手握住手柄，调整身体位置，使手臂完全伸展。
弯曲肘部降低身体，保持上臂靠近身体两侧。
继续降低，直到上臂与地板平行。
暂停片刻，然后伸展肘部将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0655.description: A push-up with your hands on a stability ball. The unstable surface adds core and shoulder stability work to the chest effort.
instructions: Place the stability ball on the ground and position yourself facing down with your hands on the ball, shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs straight out behind you, balancing on your toes.
Engage your core and lower your chest towards the ball by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将稳定球放在地上，面朝下，双手放在球上，与肩同宽。
将双腿伸直在身后，用脚趾保持平衡。
弯曲肘部，调动核心力量，将胸部向球方向降低，保持身体呈一条直线。
在底部暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0719.description: A side crunch that combines a side stretch and a contraction. It works the obliques.
instructions: Lie on your side with your bottom arm extended overhead.
Place your top hand behind your head.
Stretch along your side.
Crunch your top elbow toward your hip.
Return to the stretch.
Switch sides.

0783.description: A bodyweight squat with arms reaching overhead. It trains the legs and challenges shoulder mobility and trunk stability.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and reach both arms overhead.
Keep your arms in line with your ears and your ribs down.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your heels down and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your feet to stand tall.

0847.description: A seated biceps curl on a stability ball holding a medicine ball. It trains the biceps and balance.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a medicine ball with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and let your arms hang down by your sides.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the medicine ball up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the medicine ball back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，背部挺直。
反手握住健身球，手掌朝上，让手臂垂在身体两侧。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将药球向上卷向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并缓慢地将健身球放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0911.description: A leg curl while lying down using a band. It targets the hamstrings.
instructions: Lie face down with a band anchored to your ankles.
Keep your hips pressed down.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstrings.
Lower slowly.

0975.description: A push-up with a band around the upper arms to keep the elbows in. It trains the triceps and chest.
instructions: Place a band around your upper arms, just above the elbows.
Assume a push-up position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将一条带子绕在你的上臂上，就在肘部上方。
采取俯卧撑姿势，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体从头到脚跟呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部降低到地面，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
